import json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
ROOT=Path.cwd();D=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_original_operating_counterexample_causes_v1'
D.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write(n,o):
    p=D/n
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError('既有来源登记不可覆盖：'+str(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
now=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
prev=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_joint_operating_state_continuity_counterexamples_v1'
proposal=read(prev/'next_experiment.json')
assert proposal['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN' and proposal['experiment_id']=='E111'
for x in proposal['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256'],x['path']
quantity=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_industrial_last_period_government_full_quantity_anchor_v1/全部79原期_完整原载体量义及保守公开钟与同钟多维状态.json'
original=read(quantity)['rows']
old_cause_protocol=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_industrial_official_cause_explanations_v1/protocol.json'
old_cause_result=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_industrial_official_cause_explanations_v1/result.json'
oldcause=read(old_cause_protocol)
fixed=[x['economic_period'] for x in proposal['fixed_original_cause_periods']]
assert fixed==['2019M04','2019M05','2019M06','2023M12','2024M02']
assert not(set(fixed)&set(oldcause['targets_original_periods']))
known=[]
for period in fixed:
    q=next(x for x in original if x['economic_period']==period)
    known.append({'economic_period':period,'existing_quantity_title':q['original_title'],'existing_quantity_url':q['original_url'],
      'existing_quantity_sha256':q['original_sha256'],
      'existing_role':'FULL_NATIVE_INDUSTRIAL_QUANTITIES_AND_DEFINITIONS_NOT_SEPARATE_NATIONAL_PROFIT_CAUSE_INTERPRETATION',
      'reusable_separate_full_cause_carrier_found_in_bounded_prior_use_review':False})
prior={'reviewed_at':now,'review_scope':'既有E102三原全国工业利润解读原登记与结果、E99五目标量载体身份及E92原量取得元数据，有限工业利润/原面板/原来源目录作者定位；不宣称全repo原因宇宙被穷尽。',
 'previous_actual_cause_periods':oldcause['targets_original_periods'],'fixed_five_cause_periods_not_previous_E102_cases':True,
 'known_quantity_carriers':known,'PMI_price_and_E109_actual_price_and_quantities_are_different_roles':True,
 'reusable_full_five_target_cause_carriers':0,'new_source_GETs_already_made':0,'new_fits':0,'new_stock_labels':0}
write('有限已有原经营原因用途核对与不同角色准入_E111.json',prior)
query={
 '2019M04':'site:stats.gov.cn 解读 2019年1—4月份 工业企业 利润',
 '2019M05':'site:stats.gov.cn 解读 2019年1—5月份 工业企业 利润',
 '2019M06':'site:stats.gov.cn 解读 2019年1—6月份 工业企业 利润',
 '2023M12':'site:stats.gov.cn 解读 2023年全年 工业企业 利润',
 '2024M02':'site:stats.gov.cn 解读 2024年1—2月份 工业企业 利润'}
protocol={
 'study_id':proposal['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E111','registered_at':now,
 'status':'REGISTERED_FIVE_ORIGINAL_OPERATING_CAUSE_LOCATORS_BEFORE_REQUESTS','question':proposal['question'],
 'unit_of_analysis':proposal['unit_of_analysis'],'fixed_original_cases':proposal['fixed_original_cases'],
 'fixed_original_cause_periods':proposal['fixed_original_cause_periods'],
 'queries_fixed_before_requests':[{'economic_period':period,'q':query[period],'domains':['stats.gov.cn']} for period in fixed],
 'parents':proposal['parents']+[{'path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':sha(p)} for p in [
   prev/'next_experiment.json',quantity,old_cause_protocol,old_cause_result,D/'有限已有原经营原因用途核对与不同角色准入_E111.json']],
 'source_role':'全国工业企业利润数据的官方当期经营原因解读，与原数量通报/原价格调查/PMI价格问卷分开',
 'selection_rule':'每缺原期一次固定查询，按返回顺序选首个原国家统计局全国工业利润原因解读；原标题/首段显示原年度累计期，2023M12用全年。排除原数量通报、地方、目录、其他月份；无候选UNKNOWN，不追加查询/换载体/改原期。只有已存同原全文可复用。',
 'original_source_clock_rule':'原页面自己明确发布日期时间或明确PubDate；只有发布日期则当日末保守，不能用成文日、URL、取得日。自己的钟不晚于对应原共同截止；当前及后一原因角色不混，后一来源不能进前期特征。',
 'complete_article_rule':'保存全部原正文/原段/原数量/方法边界，真实TRS_Editor/TRS_UEDITOR/TRS_PreAppend，桌面移动副本同文只算一个原载体。同原解析字段错误可在金融标签之前留证据修正。',
 'attribution_rule':'原官方归因及其直接量分别保存，原现金收款/应收账龄变动/纯因果/预期差未知仍UNKNOWN；不据未来股价补原因。每原反例一主要机制及最多两竞争解释，原证据支持/冲突/未知区分。',
 'source_limits':{'fixed_original_locator_queries':5,'maximum_distinct_first_raw_GETs':5,'one_first_GET_per_period':True,
   'GET_concurrency_max':3,'connect_timeout_seconds':12,'read_timeout_seconds':30,'TLS_verify':True,
   'raw_GET_retries':0,'alternate_carrier_GETs':0,'extra_queries':0,'authenticated_requests':0},
 'financial_budget':{'new_financial_candidates':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_linear_regressions':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores':0,
   'new_stock_labels_generated':0,'stock_labels_read':False,'new_full_accounts':0,'existing_source_code_edits':0},
 'original79_1711_1212_identities_preserved':True,'E110_conditions_denominators_outcomes_and_baselines_unchanged':True,
 'closed_routes_preserved':proposal['closed_routes_preserved'],
 'case_selection_is_post_result_historical_explanation_not_independent_sample':True,
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED',
 'goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'prospective_forecasts':False}
write('protocol.json',protocol)
write('运行前git记录_E111.json',{'at':now,'branch':subprocess.check_output(['git','branch','--show-current'],text=True,encoding='utf-8').strip(),
 'HEAD':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True,encoding='utf-8').strip(),
 'tracked_status':subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short','--untracked-files=no'],text=True,encoding='utf-8')})
print(json.dumps({'实验':'E111','原经营原因期数':5,'原反例数':3,'复用完整原因原件':0,'固定定位预算':5,'首次GET上限':5,
 '金融模型预算':0,'源码编辑':0,'协议SHA256':sha(D/'protocol.json')},ensure_ascii=False))
